frames: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input is the approved Tiefenhall HUD mockup. Extract/recreate its crafted UI art as a production-ready TRANSPARENT sprite atlas, preserving the exact painted style: very dark walnut horizontal grain, beautifully shaded polished beveled brass rails and angular sculpted riveted corner plates. Output ONLY TWO empty wooden rectangular panels, neatly aligned and clearly separated by transparent space. Top panel: wide low frame width:height 4.5:1, matching the upper left health panel in reference, WITHOUT heart, bolt, gems, text or internal dividers. Bottom panel: long low frame width:height 8:1, matching the outer HOTBAR frame in reference, WITHOUT any internal slots, icons, dividers, text or glow. Both have straight parallel rails, substantial multi-rivet corner fittings, dark wood interior. Each panel completely within canvas, ample transparent padding, flat orthographic 2D UI asset with symmetrical clean geometry. No perspective, no scene/background, no black rectangle outside shape, no labels, no decorative objects. Transparent background must be true alpha.
sockets: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input is the approved Tiefenhall HUD mockup. Produce a transparent sprite atlas containing exactly THREE equal SQUARE empty hotbar slot tiles, side by side in ONE row with broad transparent gutters. Closely copy the small recesses of the bottom hotbar in the reference. Dark walnut horizontal wood grain, very THIN polished brass border rails, small angular corner caps with tiny round rivets occupying only 8 percent of each square side. NOT large chunky corners. First square normal: near-black rich brown wooden recess and subtle fine brass border. Second square hover: SAME geometry and wood, brighter softly illuminated golden border ONLY. Third square selected: SAME geometry, vivid warm orange-gold polished wood interior as selected pickaxe in reference, bright gold border, restrained small glow. Art style exact painted fantasy wood/multi-faceted brass reference. All three same scale, same symmetrical geometry, parallel rails, full visible shapes inside canvas. Orthographic 2D UI assets. No pickaxe or other icons, no text, no digits, no words, no background, no scenery. Genuine alpha transparency outside three squares. Wide 3:1 composition.
symbols: Use case: precise-object-edit. Reference is approved Tiefenhall HUD screenshot. Recreate only TWO isolated UI symbols from upper left: a small glossy scarlet RED HEART and a GOLDEN YELLOW LIGHTNING BOLT, side by side with generous transparent space. Heart left: compact classic smoothly rounded heart silhouette, vibrant ruby red, soft painted dimensional shading, tiny upper-left highlight, darker lower red edge. No border, no gold outline, no jewel setting. Lightning right: crisp diagonal yellow-gold lightning bolt, slight dimensional warm amber lower/right bevel and light yellow face, pointed ends, simple strong readable silhouette. Match screenshot proportions and refined painted fantasy-game style; no ornate embellishments. Symbols same height. Actual transparent alpha background. No panels, wood, text, numbers, ground, scene, frame, or cast shadow outside silhouette. Wide landscape atlas.
